Perform the Intake phase (`spec-intake` skill: `/home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal/.agents/skills/spec-intake/SKILL.md`) for story `P1-B` (`p1-b-iam-and-audit-persistence`).

### Context & Source Specification
- **Milestone file:** `docs/agents-v0/milestones/p1-contracts-and-data-models.md`
- **Milestone:** `P1 — Contracts & Data Models`
- **Story ID:** `P1-B`
- **Feature artifact path:** `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p1-b-iam-and-audit-persistence.md`
- **Milestone User Story (copy verbatim):**
  `As a compliance auditor, I want Flyway physical persistence migrations for IAM users, soft-deletable roles and permissions, user role assignments, SoD conflict rules, 13-month append-only audit log entries enforced by an immutable database trigger, and notification events alongside ArchUnit bounded-context isolation rules, so that identity and audit records cannot be tampered with or bypassed across module boundaries.`
- **Surface:** `backend` (`Surfaces: backend` — Note: `Service roots` in `docs/agents-v0/project-profile.md` is a placeholder comment, so do not add `Service root:`, matching `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p1-a-openapi-v1-contract-catalog.md`).
- **Material:** `no` (`Material: no` — all tables and bounded contexts are already approved in `docs/agents-v0/architecture.md` and `docs/agents-v0/design/system/arc-record.md`).
- **Accepted Lessons (`docs/agents-v0/lessons.md`):**
  - `L-001`: Remove untracked `._*` AppleDouble files under `app/` before running Maven Checkstyle or Vitest (Scope: Greenfield or scaffolded repositories extracted from tarballs created on macOS).
- **Repository Mapping (already completed — do NOT write a `.helper-brief.md`):**
  - Existing Flyway migration: `app/backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__baseline.sql`
  - Existing ArchUnit test: `app/backend/src/test/java/com/example/app/architecture/LayerRulesTest.java`
  - Physical data models in `docs/agents-v0/architecture.md` lines 515–811 and component plans `docs/agents-v0/design/system/components/iam-access-control.md` & `docs/agents-v0/design/system/components/audit-notifications.md`:
    - `iam` tables:
      1. `users` (`id UUID PK`, `workspace_email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE`, `display_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL`, `department VARCHAR(128)`, `directory_subject VARCHAR(255)`, `is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL`, `last_login_at TIMESTAMPTZ`, `created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL`, `updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL`)
      2. `roles` (`id UUID PK`, `role_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE`, `role_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL`, `description VARCHAR(255)`, `is_system_role BOOLEAN NOT NULL`, `is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL`, `deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ`, `version INTEGER NOT NULL`, `created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL`, `updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL`) — soft-deletable (`is_active`, `deleted_at`) and revivable
      3. `permissions` (`id UUID PK`, `permission_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE`, `http_method VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL`, `route_pattern VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL`, `module_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL`, `description VARCHAR(255)`, `is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL`, `deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ`, `created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL`, `updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL`) — soft-deletable (`is_active`, `deleted_at`) and revivable
      4. `role_permissions` (`id UUID PK`, `role_id UUID NOT NULL FK -> roles(id)`, `permission_id UUID NOT NULL FK -> permissions(id)`, `granted_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL`, `granted_by_user_id UUID FK -> users(id)`, unique constraint on `(role_id, permission_id)`)
      5. `user_role_assignments` (`id UUID PK`, `user_id UUID NOT NULL FK -> users(id)`, `role_id UUID NOT NULL FK -> roles(id)`, `assigned_by_user_id UUID FK -> users(id)`, `source_ticket_id UUID`, `expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ`, `is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL`, `created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL`, `revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ`)
      6. `sod_conflict_rules` (`id UUID PK`, `primary_role_id UUID NOT NULL FK -> roles(id)`, `conflicting_role_id UUID NOT NULL FK -> roles(id)`, `conflict_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL`, `action_scope VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL`, `enforce_in_non_prod BOOLEAN NOT NULL`, `created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL`)
    - `audit` tables:
      7. `audit_log_entries` (`id UUID PK`, `occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL`, `workspace_email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL`, `actor_user_id UUID FK -> users(id)`, `effective_view_as_role VARCHAR(64)`, `event_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL`, `action_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL`, `resource_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL`, `resource_id VARCHAR(128)`, `outcome VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL`, `correlation_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL`, `search_query_text TEXT`, `mutation_payload_json JSONB`, `client_ip VARCHAR(64)`) with B-tree index on `occurred_at`, GIN index on `mutation_payload_json`, and a PostgreSQL `BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE` trigger that raises an exception on any mutation or deletion attempt to enforce 13-month append-only immutability.
      8. `notification_events` (`id UUID PK`, `recipient_user_id UUID NOT NULL FK -> users(id)`, `recipient_email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL`, `event_category VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL`, `subject VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL`, `message_body TEXT NOT NULL`, `link_path VARCHAR(255)`, `is_read BOOLEAN NOT NULL`, `email_delivery_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL`, `email_retry_count INTEGER NOT NULL`, `last_email_error TEXT`, `created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL`, `read_at TIMESTAMPTZ`, `email_sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ`).
    - ArchUnit bounded-context isolation rules (`com.example.app.iam`, `com.example.app.configuration`, `com.example.app.execution`, `com.example.app.governance`, `com.example.app.audit`): repositories and internal domain/entity packages of one bounded context cannot be accessed directly by another bounded context (cross-context calls must go through exposed ports/services per `docs/agents-v0/architecture.md`).

### Instructions
1. Read `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p1-a-openapi-v1-contract-catalog.md` as a style and structure reference.
2. Write `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p1-b-iam-and-audit-persistence.md` with:
   - Header metadata (`Milestone: P1 — Contracts & Data Models`, `Milestone file: docs/agents-v0/milestones/p1-contracts-and-data-models.md`, `Story: P1-B`, `Surfaces: backend`, `Material: no`)
   - `## User story` (exact sentence from `p1-contracts-and-data-models.md`)
   - `## Acceptance criteria` (`AC-1` through `AC-7`, matching the milestone `Size: 7`, with `Kind: happy`, `Kind: negative`, and `Kind: edge` scenarios; ensure at least one `Kind: negative` refuses tampering/update/delete on `audit_log_entries` or invalid FK/constraint/SoD persistence, and an edge/negative scenario covers soft-delete revival and ArchUnit cross-context repository violation refusal)
   - `## Preconditions`
   - `## Desk check`
   - `## Out of scope`
   - `## NFRs`
   - `## Security-review triggers`
   - `## Regulations`
   - `## Open questions` (`none`)
   - `## Delivery approvals` (empty table header ready for approval)
3. Do NOT write `p1-b-iam-and-audit-persistence.phase-result.md` (the main session writes that). Return a concise summary of the drafted requirements artifact.

### Requirements Summary
- **Milestone & Story**: `P1 — Contracts & Data Models` / `P1-B` ([p1-contracts-and-data-models.md](file:///home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal/docs/agents-v0/milestones/p1-contracts-and-data-models.md))
- **Surface & Materiality**: `Surfaces: backend`, `Material: no`, Change Tier: `Standard`
- **User Story**:
  > As a compliance auditor, I want Flyway physical persistence migrations for IAM users, soft-deletable roles and permissions, user role assignments, SoD conflict rules, 13-month append-only audit log entries enforced by an immutable database trigger, and notification events alongside ArchUnit bounded-context isolation rules, so that identity and audit records cannot be tampered with or bypassed across module boundaries.
- **Acceptance Criteria (`AC-1` through `AC-7`)**:
  - **AC-1 (`happy`)**: Flyway migration for `users`, `roles`, `permissions`, and `role_permissions` with UUID PKs, unique constraints, `roles.version` optimistic concurrency, and soft-delete state (`is_active`, `deleted_at`).
  - **AC-2 (`happy`)**: Flyway migration for `user_role_assignments` (`expires_at`, `revoked_at`, `source_ticket_id`, `fk_user_roles_user`, `fk_user_roles_role`) and `sod_conflict_rules` (`primary_role_id`, `conflicting_role_id`, `conflict_type`, `action_scope`, `enforce_in_non_prod`).
  - **AC-3 (`happy`)**: Flyway migration for `audit_log_entries` with `fk_audit_actor`, B-tree index on `occurred_at`, and GIN index on `mutation_payload_json`.
  - **AC-4 (`happy`)**: Flyway migration for `notification_events` with `fk_notifications_recipient`, read state, and async email delivery state (`email_delivery_status`, `email_retry_count`, `last_email_error`).
  - **AC-5 (`negative`)**: PostgreSQL `BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE` immutability trigger on `audit_log_entries` rejects any `UPDATE` or `DELETE` with `"audit_log_entries is append-only"`.
  - **AC-6 (`edge`)**: Soft-delete (`is_active = false`, `deleted_at = NOW()`) and revival (`is_active = true`, `deleted_at = NULL`, `version` incremented) on `roles` and `permissions` preserves foreign keys in `role_permissions` and `user_role_assignments` while enforcing unique code constraints.
  - **AC-7 (`negative`)**: ArchUnit bounded-context isolation rules (`com.example.app.iam`, `configuration`, `execution`, `governance`, `audit`) refuse direct cross-context `..repository..`, `..entity..`, or `..domain..` access.
- **Security Triggers & Regulations**: `RBAC` and VAPT F10 append-only audit event persistence; BSP Circular 982 / 1019, Philippines Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173) & GDPR, and Internal GXI Security Baseline.
- **Open Questions**: `none`
